text:
No, pothos is not pet-safe, so it isn't a good choice if you have a cat.

If you're looking for alternatives, these Leafy plants are listed as pet-safe:
- Calathea
- Spider plant
- Parlour palm
- Boston fern
- Peperomia

If your cat may have already eaten part of a pothos, contact your vet or local poison control right away. I can also escalate to a Support Lead afterward if you'd like.

I can also share more about any of the pet-safe options, or connect you with a Plant Care Specialist (chat 9am-5pm Mon-Fri, your local time) for care advice.
